relative_definition: 100*norm(PRED-GT)/norm(GT), material pixels only, per loading frame; raw ratio retained, null only if GT norm is exactly zero
plot_near_zero_rule: Only for relative curve display: gap when frame GT L2 norm <= 1e-10 times maximum GT frame L2 norm of that case. Case3 step2 only. Raw relative ratios and absolute RMSE remain in CSV/JSON; no epsilon denominator or clipping.
RMSE_definition: sqrt(mean((PRED-GT)^2)), native stress units, material pixels only
scope: Case1-3 TRAIN, Case4 validation, Case5 test; full loading history known, not causal forecasting
